name: Dawnwall Custodians
art_brief: Melee crystal pavise infantry; broad interlocking shield with a sunrise notch, long hooked crystal spear, ivory layered shoulder guards. Distinguish the spear silhouette and weight-bearing shield stance.

name: Mirrorback Wardens
art_brief: Melee infantry with a radial mirror shield projecting rigid facet fins, short crystal sword and mirrored backplate. No bow or staff; shield and sword must read clearly.

name: Glarewing Harriers
art_brief: Light ranged skirmisher with twin-lens bow, swept wing-shaped shoulder prisms and short wind-split scarf. A mobile archer silhouette, not a melee warden.

name: Lattice Conjurers
art_brief: Ranged robed optical mage carrying a focus wand inside a suspended hexagonal lens cage, angular crystal headpiece and layered ivory mantle. Clearly different from bow-armed harriers.

name: Sunline Repeater
art_brief: Compact ranged crystal siege engine with three parallel bolt rails, rotating prism drum, brass calibration wheel and planted tripod supports. An engine, not a humanoid or giant.

name: Parallax Blades
art_brief: Melee duelist with two curved mirror sabres of unequal length, split asymmetric cloak and forked mirrored mask. Low forward stance and opposing blade arcs.

name: Harmonic Precentors
art_brief: Ranged choir mage with tall tuning-fork staff, floating concentric chime rings around shoulders and throat, long pleated ivory robes and segmented crystal halo.

name: Meridian Lockguards
art_brief: Heavy melee sentinel with tall sundial shield, mechanical locking polearm ending in two crystal hooks, noon-disc helmet and broad articulated greaves.

name: Heliostat Pathfinders
art_brief: Melee long-legged articulated construct with broad folding solar arrays over its back and a forward-reaching survey blade, exposed brass joints and crystal feet.

name: Horizon Arbiters
art_brief: Ranged survey mage bearing a huge offset circular sighting lens and ornate survey staff, long geometric tabard and narrow horizon-shaped visor. Keep the large aperture as the dominant silhouette.

name: Corona Bulwarks
art_brief: Massive MELEE walking crystal shield-body with layered radial armor fins and heavy short ram arms, a warm solar core hidden behind interlocking facets. Absolutely no ballista rails or ranged weapon.

name: Firstlight Colossus
art_brief: Towering RANGED construct with an immense chest solar aperture, orbiting crown of independent focusing lenses, heavy planted legs and broad heat-shedding shoulder plates. No hand sword; radiant aperture is its weapon.
